semantics.rust_signature: fn flash_attn_func_with_context_exact_native(backend: &CpuBackend, shape: AttentionShape, q: &[f32], k: &[f32], v: &[f32], dropout_p: f32, causal: bool, device: DeviceId, context: &ExecutionContext<'_>) -> Result<Vec<f32>, AttentionKernelError>
semantics.mutation_rule: out-of-place; q, k, and v remain immutable
semantics.alias_rule: returns fresh owned storage that aliases no input
semantics.shape_rule: q is BxNqxHxD, k is BxNkxHxD, v is BxNkxHxDv, and output is BxNqxHxDv; all dimensions are nonzero and checked
semantics.dtype_rule: the deterministic exact native fallback accepts f32 inputs and rejects execution outside its typed device contract
semantics.accumulation_dtype: f32 scores, softmax, and value accumulation
semantics.device_rule: CPU exact native fallback; non-CPU execution requires a separately certified adapter and returns typed unavailable here
semantics.numeric_rule: scaled dot product with max-subtracted softmax, zero dropout, and bottom-right aligned causal masking
semantics.tolerance: absolute 0.000001 for checked f32 forward fixtures and 0.0003 for finite-difference gradients
semantics.determinism: fixed loop order and no RNG when dropout_p is zero
semantics.cancellation_points: before allocation and once per batch-head-query row; cancellation publishes no output
semantics.vjp_rule: analytical softmax attention VJP for q, k, and v with the same mask and causal semantics
semantics.jvp_rule: analytical softmax attention JVP for q, k, and v verified against finite differences and the VJP adjoint
